description: Hash data (SHA-256/512, SHA3, Keccak-256, BLAKE2, MD5, SHA-1, RIPEMD-160, HMAC) and convert between utf8, hex, base64, base64url and base58 — exact, in one call. Useful for signatures, content addressing, EVM selectors (keccak of a function signature), and decoding blobs agents are handed. Input can itself be hex/base64/base58. Price: free. Errors: returns isError with a message for invalid input or an upstream failure (not charged).

hashes.description: sha256, sha512, sha3-256, sha3-512, keccak256, blake2b512, blake2s256, md5, sha1, ripemd160. 0-12 items. Default ["sha256","keccak256"].

hmac_key.description: if set, HMAC instead of plain hash (utf8 key)

input_encoding.description: How the input string is encoded. One of "utf8", "hex", "base64", "base58". Default "utf8".

name: hash_encode
title: Hash + encode/decode
